newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech Morav.Chem 1996 net profit dips.
newsitem.headline: Czech Morav.Chem 1996 net profit dips.

text.p: Czech Moravske Chemicek Zavody a.s. said on Monday its 1996 after-tax profit fell to 105.367 million crowns from 129.266 million, according to preliminary results.
Total turnover fell to 3.194 billion crowns from 2.963 billion crowns in 1995.
"The lowering in profit and turnover is due to a drop of prices on the (chemicals) market," the company said in a statement released from its headquarters in Ostrava.
It did not elaborate and further results were not immediately available. A date for the company's annual general meeting has not yet been set, it said.
Moravske Chemicke Zavody is majority owned by the Czech chemical and trading conglomerate Chemapol a.s.
